links.outcome: LLM accuracy on long clinical document QA benchmark, including identifying missing information
links.effect: All models struggled significantly in tasks requiring identification of missing information; accuracy levels judged insufficient for reliable clinical use.
links.quote: However, all models struggled significantly in tasks requiring the identification of missing information, highlighting a critical area for improvement in clinical data.

screen.reason: The study introduces and evaluates LLMs on the LongHealth benchmark, testing model performance on clinical QA with long documents without evaluating an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
